recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium shot of a man with dark hair and a navy t-shirt, standing in a sun-dappled forest. He has his arms crossed and leans against a large, textured tree trunk on the right. The foreground features soft, out-of-focus yellow foliage, while the background consists of dark, vertical tree trunks and filtered light. Elegant white script text is positioned in the top corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between dark vertical tree trunks
Foreground yellow bokeh balancing the dark navy shirt
Text placed in negative space of the upper canopy
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool forest shadows
coreInvariants: Leaning against a tree on the right side
White cursive typography in top corners
Out-of-focus yellow elements in lower foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the textured bark of the tree on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, moves down to the crossed arms, then follows the tree trunk up to the right-hand text, and across to the left-hand text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark forest background and upper canopy provide space for the white typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest greens and dark browns in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Navy blue of the shirt against the warm skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow bokeh in the foreground and crisp white for the text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark shirt/background and the bright highlights on the face and foreground foliage.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to natural earth tones and navy

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a handwritten feel
letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight suggesting a brush or felt-tip pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are expressive and larger than lowercase
Ascenders and descenders are moderate, not exaggerated

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

composition.position: Top left and top right corners
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the dark upper background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for both name and title to maintain a personal, intimate feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal but elegant handwritten look
Reflects the intimate portrait nature of the image

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man with dark hair in a navy t-shirt, arms crossed, leaning against a large tree in a forest. Include soft yellow out-of-focus foliage in the foreground and dark vertical trees in the background with dappled sunlight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white, casual brush-script text in the top left and top right corners, ensuring it is legible against the dark background.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the top corners?
Is the foreground bokeh yellow and soft?
Is the man's pose arms-crossed and leaning?
Is the lighting warm and dappled?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the navy shirt
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name or title from the original image
Ensure the script is a new custom creation or a different font

avoid: Overly busy backgrounds that obscure the text

postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is not overlapping the subject
Ensure the tree texture is visible
Confirm the yellow bokeh doesn't distract from the face
recipe.reuseFormula: Medium shot portrait + forest setting + crossed arms + tree lean + foreground bokeh + corner-placed script typography.
